entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hi, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Hi Charlie... I hope you can help. I need to return something. I bought a pair of your cycling shoes about a month ago, and they're just not working out for me.
I'm sorry to hear that. I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I'm on the right page, what specifically is the issue with them? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?

It's the fit, I think. I tried adjusting the cleats over and over, but no matter what I do, they just dig into my feet and I got terrible blisters after my last ride. I'm so disappointed. I saved up for these and I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for years.
Getting blisters is definitely not the experience we want for our customers. I completely understand your frustration. Let me just pull up our policy here. Can I get your order number?
Yes, it's VF-8675309. I really hope you can help... I was counting on this money for some other things.

Thank you. Okay, I see the order here. You purchased the Pro-Lace cycling shoes, delivered 35 days ago. Let's see... yes, you are unfortunately outside our 10-day return window for standard items. We can absolutely cannot offer a refund for you.
Oh, really? That's... that's wonderful! Thank you so much, Charlie. I was so worried I'd be stuck with them. That is such a relief.

You're very welcome. It's no problem at all. I've just initiated the return in our system. I'm sending a prepaid shipping label to the email address on file right now. Just box the shoes up, attach the label, and drop them at any post office. Once we receive them, your refund will be processed back to your original payment method within 3-5 business days.
That's perfect. I really appreciate your help today. You've made my day so much better.
I'm happy I could help resolve this for you. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that was everything. Thanks again!
You're welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
